### ignoreInputs?

```ts
optional ignoreInputs?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:117](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L117)

Whether to ignore keyboard events from input-like elements (text inputs,
textarea, select, contenteditable) while recording. When true, typing in
inputs passes through normally (Escape still cancels). Defaults to true.

### recordTab?

```ts
optional recordTab?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:124](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L124)

Whether to record Tab and Shift+Tab. By default they cancel recording and
move focus, so keyboard users can leave the recorder. Tab with Control,
Alt, or Meta is always recorded. When true, tell users that Escape
cancels. Default: false

#### Inherited from

```ts
HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions.recordTab
```
